lhs: Dense forward convolution with one spatial axis of unit kernel size, grouped feature and batch offsets, summing the actual kernel-tap and input-channel products at each physical output coordinate.
rhs: Independently transpose input and kernel to output order; reshape/broadcast kernel singleton axes and multiply typed operand entries pointwise.
conditions: Arbitrary independent rank-three dimension-number bijections, no padding, stride/dilations one, dense static same-type input/output, kernel-input-feature extent one and input/output features equal featureGroupCount. Positive, nonsimultaneously nontrivial group counts; kernel output features and input batch divisible by batch group count.
types: Exact Nat values; one-spatial-axis model allowing any positive feature-group count and zero batch/spatial extents. Only representable finite arithmetic transfers to fixed machine interpretations.
overlap: Historical convolve_single_channel and convolve_eq_productReduction are normalized value laws. New work resolves physical-number transposes, grouped batch offset, kernel broadcast with retained singleton features, output shape and typed operand reads. No claim for additional spatial axes, mixed-type conversions or sparse/backward convolution.
